name: agent-web
title: Agent-readable web
summary: Agents read the app's public pages as Markdown (a .md twin of every page, Accept: text/markdown), find everything from /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt, and, in a signed-in tab, call the app's read tools over WebMCP as the person.

env.name: AGENT_WEB_WEBMCP_ENABLED
env.doc: Offer the app's read tools to browser agents on signed-in pages (WebMCP). false keeps llms.txt and the Markdown twins only.

env.name: AGENT_WEB_TOOL_CALLS_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: WebMCP tool calls allowed per person per minute.

stitch: Rewrite web/src/features/agent-web/site.ts: a one-sentence summary, an about paragraph (who it's for, units, limits, demo data) and conventions agents must know.

Give every public page a Markdown twin in web/src/features/agent-web/pages.ts (each proxy.ts PUBLIC_PATHS entry except sign-in, including features' public pages such as booking pages or published docs): pattern, title, one-line summary, examples for patterns with params, and a render built with md.ts from bundled content or the public API.
Write prescriptive descriptions on every read tool (app.ToolProvider): browser agents see exactly those over WebMCP.
Projects made before 2026-11-16: copy the scaffold:imports and scaffold:proxy anchors and the PROXY_HANDLERS loop into web/proxy.ts from the template before installing.
